Workplace Quirk Permits.text: A workplace Quirk permit lets an employee use a registered Quirk on the job, for set tasks at a set site, and nowhere else. The employer applies to the city with the job description, the worker's registry record and a safety plan, and an inspector approves the uses the permit names: a strength Quirk moving freight in a warehouse, a heat Quirk at a forge, a sensing Quirk inspecting pipes, a water Quirk on a fishing boat. Workers with permits receive safety training and wear an ID badge marked with the permit. Using the Quirk for a task the permit does not name, or outside the site, counts as ordinary illegal public use, and an employer who pushes workers past the permit faces fines and loses it. Construction, shipping, farming, manufacturing and demolition use permits most. A permit is not a hero license: a permitted worker who sees an emergency nearby has no more authority to act than any other citizen.
